msgs.t: 10 minutes, then questions from the panel. Bring slides.

slides.b: What's wrong, who it affects, one number. The panel decides here.
Three, each starting with a verb: to find, to compare, to measure.
Sample, tool, analysis, in one row of boxes. Not a page of text.

slides.h: Gap in the literature, by name.
slides.b: "Studies so far looked at X, none at Y." That's your reason to exist.
Then stop and say "thank you". Let the questions come to you.

slides.h:
Your defence slides
in PowerPoint. KES 20.
slides.b:
Tell Toso your topic, objectives and method. Get the finished deck, ready to present.
Pay with M-Pesa. First deck free. No card, no monthly bill.
